structured_output.rationale: All three lines carry CO-29 (timely filing expired) with MOA N211. But the 277CA shows the original claim (TRC95085471) was accepted 2025-02-06 — 12 days after the DOS of 2025-01-25. The 837 in hand is dated 2025-08-19 with CLM05-3=1 (new original), which the payer treated as a fresh filing ~7 months post-DOS. The original was filed timely; the denial is disputable with the 277CA acceptance report.

root_cause.explanation: Claim resubmitted 2025-08-19 as CLM05-3=1 (new original), ~7 months after DOS. Payer denied CO-29. Original claim TRC95085471 was accepted 2025-02-06 per 277CA — 12 days post-DOS, clearly within any commercial window.

next_action.detail: File a timely-filing appeal attaching the 2025-02-06 277CA (STC A2:20) as proof the original claim was accepted within 12 days of DOS. Dispute the receipt date underlying the CO-29 denial; do not resubmit another new claim.

evidence.fact: All three service lines denied CO-29; claim-level MOA N211; $0 paid; filing indicator CI
Original claim TRC95085471 accepted by payer 2025-02-06 (STC A2:20), 12 days after DOS 2025-01-25
Resubmission dated 2025-08-19 sent with CLM05-3=1 (new original), causing payer to evaluate filing date as August 2025
CO-29 with proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report; dispute receipt date

citations.rule: Proof of accepted submission inside window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report
CO-29 with no exception → do_not_resubmit; exception applies when acceptance proof exists
